card.text: Explore Thrymr, a moon of Saturn, through its lightcurve-constrained shape approximation.

introduction.text: Thrymr’s long rotation period remains tentative. Its modest elongation is a lower-limit interpretation of unresolved brightness measurements, with assumed depth and orientation. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Light-curve shape approximation
model.summary: Approximate ellipsoid adopting minimum equatorial ratio 1.21:1 under uniform reflectivity. Equal short axes and volume scaling are assumed. Orientation and phase are illustrative. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
